exact_statement: There exists a universal C > 0 such that for every n >= 1, every isotropic log-concave probability measure mu on R^n, and every locally Lipschitz f in L^2(mu) with finite Dirichlet energy, Var_mu(f) <= C integral |grad f|^2 dmu. Isotropic means E X=0 and Cov(X)=I_n. The full-dimensional covariance-normalized version is lambda_max(Cov(mu)) <= C_P(mu) <= C lambda_max(Cov(mu)).

posterior_poincare_external_input.statement: For a t-uniformly log-concave probability measure, C_P <= 1/t.
posterior_poincare_external_input.application: The Gaussian observation posterior for Y=sqrt(t)X+G is t-uniformly log-concave when the prior is log-concave, including convex support.
